faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about discovering events on Nuqta
faq.a1: Nuqta is a bilingual (Arabic/English) event discovery and management platform. We help you discover workshops, bazaars, concerts, art exhibitions, and cultural gatherings — all in one place.
faq.q2: How do I find events near me?
faq.a2: Simply browse our homepage to see upcoming events. You can filter by category (workshops, bazaars, concerts, exhibitions, food), search by neighborhood, or use your location to find events near you.
faq.a3: Yes! Browsing and discovering events is completely free. You can book events, save favorites, and leave reviews at no cost. Nuqta only charges event organizers who want to manage their events professionally.
faq.a4: Nuqta is fully bilingual — available in both Arabic and English. All email confirmations and notifications are automatically sent in both languages. You can switch between languages anytime.
faq.q5: How do I book an event?
faq.a5: Find an event you like, select your ticket type, and complete your booking. You'll receive a bilingual confirmation email with all the details. Payment is via bank transfer — simply upload your payment proof and the organizer will confirm your booking.
faq.q6: Can I organize my own events on Nuqta?
faq.a6: Absolutely! Nuqta offers a professional event management platform for organizers. You can start for free with one event, and our system handles automated bookings, bilingual emails, attendance lists, and analytics. Visit our For Vendors page to learn more.

WhyNuqta.title: Why Elite Event Organizers Choose Nuqta
WhyNuqta.subtitle: Stop struggling with scattered tools. Discover how we solve your real problems.
WhyNuqta.reason1_desc: Every event gets a polished, SEO-optimized page with booking form, map, gallery, and social sharing — ready to impress your audience and convert visitors into attendees.
WhyNuqta.reason2_desc: Fully automated system sends booking confirmations and reminders in both Arabic and English, and manages attendance lists for you.
WhyNuqta.reason3_title: One place for your guest list
WhyNuqta.reason3_desc: Track bookings and payment status to help manage attendance.

reason1.problem_desc: You direct people to DM you, or share a Google Form link. No professional event page, no instant confirmations, no automated follow-up. Potential attendees bounce before they even register.
reason1.agitate: The problem? You're competing with organizers who have professional booking pages, while you're still copy-pasting bank details in WhatsApp.
reason1.solution_title: Professional event pages that convert visitors into bookings
reason1.solution_desc: Every event gets its own polished page with booking form, map, photo gallery, and ticket options. Attendees book in seconds. You look professional from day one — and your SEO-optimized page drives organic traffic from Google.

reason2.problem_desc: Every booking turns into a long conversation. 'Did you receive the payment?' 'What's the address?' 'What time?' Same questions, 50 times. Your messages are drowning in chaos.
reason2.agitate: And at the last minute? Chasing unpaid bookings, sending manual reminders, and hoping no one forgets to attend. This isn't work—it's an administrative nightmare.
reason2.solution_title: Goodbye manual work: Full bilingual automation
reason2.solution_desc: Our system automatically sends booking confirmations and reminders in Arabic and English. Generates attendance lists with one click. Tracks payments in one dashboard. You just create the event—we handle the rest.

reason3.problem_desc: You built your reputation through months of hard work. Then a competitor leaves a fake one-star review that destroys everything. Or worse—someone angry who didn't even attend.
reason3.agitate: One bad review is enough to turn away dozens of potential customers. And you're completely helpless because other platforms allow anyone to review—even those who never bought a ticket.
reason3.solution_title: Protected reputation: Only actual attendees can review
reason3.solution_desc: Our verified system only allows attendees who actually showed up to write reviews. Zero fake reviews, zero competitors sabotaging your reputation. Every review is authentic from a real participant.

FAQ.title: Got Questions? We've Got Answers.
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before making the switch
FAQ.q1: How is Nuqta different from managing events through DMs?
FAQ.a1: Nuqta brings your event page, registrations, guest list and payment proofs together. The organizer still checks payments and confirms bookings.
FAQ.q2: What if I only organize events once in a while?
FAQ.a2: That's exactly what the Free plan is for. Create up to 3 active events at no cost. Use it for your next event, pause it when you're not organizing, and come back whenever you're ready. Zero monthly fees. When your business grows and you need more, upgrading takes one click — and you can downgrade again anytime.
FAQ.a3: The entire platform is in Arabic and English. All attendee emails are automatically sent in both languages — you never have to translate anything manually. Whether your audience speaks Arabic, English, or both — Nuqta has you covered.
FAQ.q4: How do I promote my events?
FAQ.a4: Nuqta gives you powerful promotion tools built in. Every event gets its own professional page optimized for Google search. You also get auto-generated branded share cards and bilingual captions — share to Instagram, WhatsApp, or Facebook in one tap. Your custom vendor page (nuqta.ist/v/your-brand) acts as your professional portfolio. Think of it as your marketing toolkit + management platform in one.
FAQ.q5: What happens to my data if I cancel?
FAQ.a5: Request a copy of your data or account deletion at info@nuqta.ist. Some records may need to be retained to resolve disputes or meet legal obligations.
FAQ.q6: Do I need any technical skills?
FAQ.a6: No coding is needed. Create your event page using the form and contact us if you need help.
FAQ.q7: How does the bilingual system work?
FAQ.a7: Like magic, honestly. You enter your event details once. Every email, confirmation, and notification is automatically sent in both Arabic and English to your attendees. No duplicate work, no manual translation. Your events look professional in both languages without any extra effort.
FAQ.q8: What payment methods can attendees use?
FAQ.a8: Currently, attendees submit payment via bank transfer and upload their proof directly through the platform. You verify and manage everything from your dashboard — no more digging through scattered screenshots in DMs. Integrated payment gateway is coming soon.
FAQ.q9: How does the verified review system protect me?
FAQ.a9: Eligible users can leave reviews. Contact us to report an inappropriate review for moderation.
FAQ.q10: Can I try everything before paying?
FAQ.a10: Absolutely. The Free plan gives you access to all core features with up to 3 active events. Test the platform — bookings, emails, your own landing page, everything. When you're ready for growth tools like discount codes, CRM, and advanced analytics, upgrade to Pro.
FAQ.q11: Am I locked into a contract?
FAQ.a11: The Free plan has no subscription fee. Review the price, renewal and cancellation terms of any paid offer before choosing it.

About.title: About Nuqta
About.subtitle: Connecting the heart of your community.
About.mission_desc: Nuqta is the heartbeat of your community. We are a platform dedicated to bridging cultures, fostering connections, and centralizing the vibrant events and services that make your city home to so many.
About.story_desc: Since our inception, Nuqta has aimed to provide a trusted source for discovering workshops, galleries, bazaars, and community gatherings. We believe that by providing professional tools to organizers and a seamless discovery experience for users, we can help our community thrive together.
About.name_desc: In Arabic, 'Nuqta' (نقطة) means 'point' or 'dot'. We see ourselves as the meeting point — the central dot on the map where everyone comes together to start something new.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_desc: We process the account and contact information, event details, bookings and payment proofs you provide. Age and gender in the registration form are optional. Do not upload full card numbers, passwords or unrelated transaction details.
Privacy.s2_desc: We use data to operate your account, manage and communicate about bookings, provide support and protect the platform. Marketing use requires the appropriate permissions; contact us to object to marketing.
Privacy.s3_desc: The event organizer receives booking and contact information needed to manage your attendance and verify payment. We use providers for hosting, authentication, storage, email and monitoring, including Supabase, Vercel, Resend and Sentry. Processing may take place in other countries depending on those providers’ configurations.
Privacy.s4_desc: If you allow optional analytics, tools configured through Google Tag Manager, such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, may measure usage. Avoid entering sensitive financial information in free-text fields. You can change your analytics choice using Privacy settings.
Privacy.s5_desc: We use cookies for sign-in, language, your selected country and signup attribution. Optional Google Tag Manager analytics are loaded only after you allow them. You can also manage cookies in your browser.
Privacy.s6_desc: To request access, correction, a copy of your data or account deletion, email info@nuqta.ist. We may need to verify your identity. We review deletion requests alongside active bookings, disputes and legal obligations and will explain any records that must be retained.
Privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, please contact us at
